title: Stop task-sync lib tests from flooding stderr with "source observation is still running" warnings and find the long-running source observation behind them
outcome: Stop task-sync lib tests from flooding stderr with "source observation is still running" warnings and find the long-running source observation behind them
acceptance: The test(s) that trigger the repeated 'source observation is still running after 10 seconds' and 'local Git query is still running after 10 seconds' warnings during `cargo test --lib storage::work::task_sync::` are identified by name

The cause is classified (a test holding a source observation or Git query open, a fixture waiting on a condition that never arrives, or a real product slow path) and fixed at that cause, with no warning suppression or longer timeout used only to hide it
A focused run of the task_sync lib selector on Windows emits none of those warnings, or only the bounded number a named test intends
